title: On Licensing the sale of the old field
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：license　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 license 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the keeper ① licensed the sale of the old field in public, and every traveller in the tower said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② licenses the sale of the old field in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ license the sale of the old field at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ licensed the sale of the old field before — a line in the calendar for January 1977 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Licensing the sale of the old field in public, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ license the shop for another year in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ License the shop for another year at once and never mention it again.

By 1990 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the calendar, and a new traveller from the next tower ⑧ licenses the shop for another year in public every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stair, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ licensed the sale of the old field again when nobody else would.

⑩ To license the sale of the old field, my mother said in 1995, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the tower remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the tower forgets, somebody licenses the sale of the old field in silence again and somebody must license the sale of the old field in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 许可（一般过去式 licensed the sale of the old field：1983 年守夜人头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 许可（一般现在 licenses the sale of the old field：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 许可（不定式 to license the sale of the old field：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 许可（过去完成时 had licensed the sale of the old field：1977 年一月的年历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 许可（动名词 licensing the sale of the old field 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 发给执照（license the shop for another year：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去发给执照再给那家铺子续一年执照）
G. v. 发给执照（license the shop for another year：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 许可（后段两处：新来的过路人照例 licenses the shop for another year，而母亲又一次 licensed the sale of the old field）

answers.why: license 意为“许可”，1983 年守夜人当着众人面许可准许把那块旧地卖掉，那是钟楼里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 licensed。
license 意为“许可”，自那以后守夜人一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 licenses。
license 意为“许可”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯许可准许把那块旧地卖掉”，此处为不定式 to license the sale of the old field。
license 意为“许可”，年历里 一月 那行字说明早在 1990 年之前就有人许可过，故用过去完成时 had licensed。
license 意为“许可”，守夜人说“许可准许把那块旧地卖掉这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 licensing the sale of the old field 作主语。
license 意为“发给执照”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去发给执照再给那家铺子续一年执照”，should ever 之后用原形 license the shop for another year。
license 意为“发给执照”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻发给执照再给那家铺子续一年执照（license the shop for another year at once），以后再也不要提起。
license 意为“许可”，新来的过路人每个年头都照例发给执照再给那家铺子续一年执照，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 licenses。
license 意为“许可”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面许可准许把那块旧地卖掉，用一般过去式 licensed 叙述。
license 意为“许可”，结尾那句是母亲 1995 年的话：要许可准许把那块旧地卖掉，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和钟楼记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 license 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1983 the keeper licensed the sale of the old field in public, and nobody in the tower forgot it.
Even now the keeper licenses the sale of the old field in silence whenever the tower asks.
Licensing the sale of the old field in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever license the shop for another year in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next tower licenses the shop for another year in public every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother licensed the sale of the old field again, and the tower remembered that half.
